# Automated test catalogue and traceability

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-test-catalogue.mjs. Do not edit by hand: change the script or the tests, then regenerate. -->

Every automated test in the repository, as the test runners themselves list them, and a matrix from each requirement in `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-06-production-rebuild-design.md` to the tests that cover it.

**Regenerate** after changing tests, from the repository root. It needs only `npm ci`: it does not start a browser or a database, and it does not run anything.

```sh
node scripts/generate-test-catalogue.mjs           # write this file
node scripts/generate-test-catalogue.mjs --check   # exit 1 if this file is out of date
```

The script fails if a matrix row names a test or a manual case that no longer exists. Requirement rows are maintained by hand in `REQUIREMENTS` in that script. Test rows are not. IDs hash the file and test name, so renaming a test changes its ID.

This lists what exists. It does not say tests passed: for results, see `docs/testing/TEST-REPORT.md`. Manual cases are in `docs/testing/MANUAL-TEST-CASES.md`.

Level definitions, and what each does and doesn't prove, are in `docs/testing/TEST-STRATEGY.md`.

## Traceability matrix

143 requirements: 98 covered, 29 partial, 16 with no automated test.

**Covered** means a test exercises the requirement on the stack it runs on (localhost, emulated devices). It does not mean proved in production. **Partial** means part of it is untested: the note says which. **None** means no automated test. A row with many tests shows the first few, and the rest are in the catalogue under that file.

## Requirements with no automated coverage

Stated openly, so nobody assumes otherwise. Manual cases, where they exist, are the only check.

| Req | Requirement | Why not, and how it is checked | Manual |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SEC-AUTH-07 | Constant-time compare | By reading `constantTimeEqual` in `crypto.ts`. No timing test: one would be noise on shared CI. | None |
| SEC-AUTH-14 | Phone OTP deferred | Nothing to test: not built. | None |
| SEC-DB-05 | Parameterised queries only | By reading: tagged templates throughout. `.unsafe` appears only in the migration runner and in dev and test setup scripts, not in request paths. No test and no lint rule enforces it. | None |
| SEC-CLI-05 | No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` | Source search on 2026-11-06 found none. No test or lint rule prevents one being added. The CSP is a backstop. | None |
| SEC-SUP-01 | Lockfile, `npm audit` clean | A CI step, not a test. `npm ci` and `npm audit` are in `ci.yml`, which has never run. | MT-SEC-14, MT-DEP-17 |
| SEC-SUP-02 | Dependabot, CodeQL, CI gates, secret scanning guidance, exact-pinned Actions | Config exists (`.github/`, pinned by SHA). GitHub Actions has never run. Secret scanning is a repository setting. | MT-DEP-17 |
| PRI-14 | Drafted from what the app really does, marked for legal review | A human review. Has not happened. | MT-CLN-09 |
| CLN-11 | Breathing tools warn to stop if dizzy | No test mentions it. Present in source at setup and during the session. | MT-TOL-01, MT-CLN-06 |
| PRD-05 | Check-in: large tap targets, progress | Progress is not asserted. Targets only by axe `target-size` (24px). | MT-CHK-01, MT-DEV-10 |
| PRD-09 | Result: difficulty shown | Stored and sent are tested. The sentence on the result screen is not. | MT-RES-02 |
| PRD-13 | Tools: optional haptic | No test. Emulation has no vibration. | MT-TOL-04 |
| PRD-21 | Help: no animation | By reading `Help.tsx`. | MT-HELP-16 |
| UX-02 | Desktop is a centred, comfortable layout | No test runs at desktop width. | MT-DEV-05 |
| UX-04 | Safe-area insets, `dvh`, thumb reach | Need a real notch and real browser toolbars. | MT-DEV-08, MT-DEV-09, MT-DEV-10 |
| UX-20 | Warm and human | A human judgement. | MT-CLN-10 |
| NG-04 | No diagnosis, AI advice, invented statistics, or gamification | A copy review. | MT-CLN-04 |

The **Partial** rows above also carry gaps, and these three matter most: CLN-08 (no call placed), PRD-15 (nobody has listened), and UX-07 (keyboard walked on some screens, by a script, not a person).
